description: §14.8.9 RULING S445 #4 — an HMAC keyed by a compile-time CONSTANT (`hmac("public-key", String(u.pin))`) is a digest of the protected value, reversible by enumeration; returning it is E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: RULING S445 #4 (refines S443 #7): only an HMAC whose key is not a compile-time constant counts as keyed. A literal / const-bound / template-of-literals / concatenation-of-constants key is public, so `hmac("public-key", pin)` of a 4-digit pin falls in 10^4 tries — the bare-digest reasoning. A key from env / config / a secret store / a runtime value still declassifies.
